info.title: iTelemetry APIs
info.description: The iTelemetry API provides robust monitoring capabilities for infrastructure and applications, allowing users to track critical metrics efficiently. This API enables users to retrieve real-time status updates or logs within specific timeframes, using parameters such as server names, thresholds, and duration. Users can specify a boolean flag to fetch either the latest status of critical services or comprehensive logs. Additionally, the API supports filtering records based on a threshold value between 0 and 100, helping identify performance anomalies. The flexible time format ('yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM:SS') allows users to set precise data collection windows, enhancing diagnostic accuracy.

post.summary: Application Family, Application CI, Support Group, Managed By Group
post.description: Retrieve the mapping of Application Family with its corresponding Application Configuration Item (CI), Managed By Group, and Support Group.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description:
Description of each Key of the parameter object

  1. Array of Application Families: For example, ['All'] implies that all application families are included. On the other hand, ['Avasure', 'Aria'] specifies that only the two mentioned application families should be considered.
  2. Array of Application CI's: For instance, ['All'] means all application configuration items are included. Conversely, ['Avasure-WAMT', 'Aria-AK'] indicates that only the specified application CIs are to be considered.
  3. Array of Managed By Group: For example, ['All'] denotes that all managed by groups are included. In contrast, ['IS Oncology', 'IS Cardiology'] specifies that only the two mentioned groups should be considered.
  4. Array of Support Group:For instance, ['All'] suggests that all support groups are included. Alternatively, ['IS Oncology', 'IS Cardiology'] indicates that only the two specified support groups are to be considered.

post.description: Retrieve CPU Utilization data of Azure, OnPrem VMs
post.summary: Azure, OnPremise VMs CPU utilization Data onboarded into Azure Monitor/SCOM

parameters.name: user
parameters.description:
Description of each Key of the parameter object

  1. filters:
    1. Array of Application Families: For example, ['All'] implies that all application families are included. On the other hand, ['Avasure', 'Aria'] specifies that only the two mentioned application families should be considered.
    2. Array of Application CI's: For instance, ['All'] means all application configuration items are included. Conversely, ['Avasure-WAMT', 'Aria-AK'] indicates that only the specified application CIs are to be considered.
    3. Array of Managed By Group: For example, ['All'] denotes that all managed by groups are included. In contrast, ['IS Oncology', 'IS Cardiology'] specifies that only the two mentioned groups should be considered.
    4. Array of Support Group:For instance, ['All'] suggests that all support groups are included. Alternatively, ['IS Oncology', 'IS Cardiology'] indicates that only the two specified support groups are to be considered.
  2. aggregate:A boolean value (yes/no) that determines whether to fetch only the most recent status of critical services and URLs or to retrieve all logs within the selected time frame.
  3. serverName:A comma-separated list of server names, for example: 'avaxxxxx, mosayyyyy, acuzzzzz'.
  4. threshold:A value between 0 and 100, which serves as a threshold for retrieving all records that exceed this specified limit within the chosen or specified duration. Applicable only when 'aggregate' value is equal to no
  5. start_time:The start time of the duration for which we want to retrieve data, in the following datetime format: 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM:SS'.
  6. end_time:The end time of the duration for which we want to retrieve data, in the following datetime format: 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM:SS'.

post.description: Retrieve Incident Data based on Timestamp, MI Status and Incident Status.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description:
Description of each Key of the parameter object

  1. filters:
    1. Array of Application Families: For example, ['All'] implies that all application families are included. On the other hand, ['Avasure', 'Aria'] specifies that only the two mentioned application families should be considered.
    2. Array of Application CI's: For instance, ['All'] means all application configuration items are included. Conversely, ['Avasure-WAMT', 'Aria-AK'] indicates that only the specified application CIs are to be considered.
    3. Array of Managed By Group: For example, ['All'] denotes that all managed by groups are included. In contrast, ['IS Oncology', 'IS Cardiology'] specifies that only the two mentioned groups should be considered.
    4. Array of Support Group:For instance, ['All'] suggests that all support groups are included. Alternatively, ['IS Oncology', 'IS Cardiology'] indicates that only the two specified support groups are to be considered.
  2. aggregate:A boolean value(yes/no) that determines whether to fetch only count of Incidents categorized based on incident status, or to retrieve all logs within the selected time frame.
  3. miBool:A boolean values(yes/no) which decides if the incident data required are MI or all Incidents.
  4. active:A boolean values(yes/no) which decides if the incident data required are currently active or all Incidents irrespective of incident status within the selected time frame.
  5. start_time:The start time of the duration for which we want to retrieve data, in the following datetime format: 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM:SS'.
  6. end_time:The end time of the duration for which we want to retrieve data, in the following datetime format: 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM:SS'.
